result.summary: No critical blockers are visible, but the page has noticeable horizontal-scroll clipping: category chips and restaurant cards are cut off at the right edge, and one restaurant name is truncated mid-word. A couple of minor contrast/labeling improvements are also visible.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category row is clipped at the right edge, with an additional chip only partially visible after “Healthy” and no clear fade/scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fading, padding, or a scroll indicator so clipped chips look intentional and users can tell more categories are available.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third restaurant card is cut off by the viewport and its title appears truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”, making the content look broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card widths/peek amount or add horizontal scroll cues so partially visible cards are clearly intentional and titles do not appear accidentally cut off.

issues.description: Search placeholder text “Restaurants, dishes, groceries” is light gray on a light gray field and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast or darken the placeholder text while preserving placeholder styling.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons overlaid on restaurant images appear to be icon-only controls with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as “Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar” and ensure sufficient touch target size.
